media.ext_alt_text: Orange and white traffic barrels block lanes on U.S. 49 southbound on a sunny day with trees in the background and grass in the foreground. A road buckle can also be seen.
U.S. 49 with markings labeled "25 10:25" and three traffic cones in left lane beside a patch of buckled roadway in the right lane, with trees and a clear sky in the background.

U.S. 49 southbound is undergoing maintenance with orange traffic cones lined up along the edge of the left lane and a buckled patch of roadway in the right lane, surrounded by green trees under a clear blue sky.

Large crack in an asphalt road section of U.S. 49 southbound with visible damage to the surface, surrounded by trees and a safety cone visible to one side. This crack formed in the left lane of the highway last week and has since worsened.
